# SYSTEM OVERVIEW

Status: CURRENT
Human comprehension status: PASS

## One-minute summary

Project: MAX MTF

Purpose: Quantitative trading research and governed deployment system for strategy optimization, multi-timeframe data authority, model research, Challenger/Champion lifecycle, ONNX deployment, and MT5 execution.

Primary users: Owner/operator, Control Room reviewer, Builder/repair agent, Quant research reviewer

Expected outcomes:
- Produce causally valid research evidence and qualified Strategy/Model Challengers
- Keep promotion authority explicit and auditable
- Preserve exact source, data, model, and runtime lineage across research and deployment
- Fail closed when required scientific or external runtime evidence is missing
- Keep the public Git repository source-only; Owner runtime evidence and private market/runtime artifacts stay outside public Git history

## Main data flow

- Owner/MT5 history -> MTF_DATA: Native M5/M15/H1/H4 inputs are resolved to one broker symbol and causally normalized.
- MTF_DATA -> RESEARCH: Validated datasets, alignment and lineage feed strategy/model research.
- STRATEGY_OPT -> GOVERNANCE: Eligible optimizer winner is registered as Strategy Challenger, never auto-promoted.
- RESEARCH + MODELS -> FACTORY: Candidate evidence progresses through deterministic lifecycle gates.
- FACTORY -> GOVERNANCE: Qualified Factory winner is registered as Model Challenger before any Champion promotion.
- SCIENTIST -> RESEARCH/FACTORY: Advisory proposals are admitted only through deterministic legality/capacity/scientific checks.
- GOVERNANCE -> EA_RUNTIME: Only explicit accepted release/Champion authority may change production deployment identity.
- ACCEPTANCE -> project state: Executed evidence constrains what may be claimed as PASS.

## Main user workflows

### FLOW-EA-RUNTIME — EA inherited single-timeframe execution and ONNX/shadow runtime

Describe current MQL5 runtime authority without pretending the new static Python/JS sequence generator can parse MQL5 OnTick internals.

Authority: EA_v2_00/baseline/Max_MTF.mq5 + active release authority

- INIT -> RUNTIME_GUARDS : Load runtime inputs/release/model state
- RUNTIME_GUARDS -> SIGNAL_EVALUATION : Evaluate inherited seven-family strategy and optional ONNX/shadow context
- SIGNAL_EVALUATION -> TRADE_OR_SKIP : Apply deterministic execution/risk policy; live trading disabled by default unless explicitly allowed
- TRADE_OR_SKIP -> TELEMETRY : Write trade/training/shadow evidence according to runtime settings

### FLOW-LOCAL-ACCEPTANCE — Local cumulative acceptance and current evidence seal

Execute the exact ordered 75-gate suite and seal one current candidate acceptance claim without upgrading external runtime gates.

Authority: ModelLab/acceptance/runners/run_acceptance.py

- RUNNING -> GATE_PASS : Run next exact gate/script pair and verify runtime/tree authority did not mutate
- GATE_PASS -> RUNNING : Continue ordered suite
- RUNNING -> GATE_FAIL : Any gate returns nonzero or authority mutates
- GATE_PASS -> 75_PASS : All 75 exact ordered pairs pass under FRESH_FULL
- 75_PASS -> CURRENT_EVIDENCE_SYNC_PASS : Rotate only canonical mutable current acceptance claim/report identity

### FLOW-MODEL-FACTORY — AUTO/Manual research Factory to Model Challenger

Execute governed model research from Discovery through protected Forward evidence and register a qualified Model Challenger.

Authority: Deterministic Factory stage functions; production AUTO orchestration delegates to LangGraph.

- PREPARE -> DISCOVERY_FULL_WFA : Freeze research contract and candidate universe
- DISCOVERY_FULL_WFA -> POOL : Admit only Full-WFA qualified candidates
- POOL -> CPCV : Run purged CPCV with required seed confirmation for DL/hybrid
- CPCV -> TOURNAMENT : Replay survivors on pre-frozen tournament evidence
- TOURNAMENT -> MONTE_CARLO : Stress exact survivor return sets
- MONTE_CARLO -> FRESH_FORWARD : Enter predeclared protected forward validation
- FRESH_FORWARD -> MODEL_CHALLENGER : Register qualified winner as Model Challenger
- FRESH_FORWARD -> WAITING_FOR_FORWARD_DATA : Evidence is immature but not failed

### FLOW-MTF1-CLOSURE — MTF-1 data and final closure

Build and prove canonical multi-timeframe data authority, then bind local and Owner external evidence into final MTF-1 closure.

Authority: ModelLab/mtf/mtf1_closure_bootstrap.py::_run_canonical_chain + deterministic MTF/acceptance verifiers

- PRECHECK -> LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE : Resolve canonical Python environment and shared closure_run_id
- LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE -> OWNER_MT5_EVIDENCE : Require fresh 75/75 local acceptance
- OWNER_MT5_EVIDENCE -> METAEDITOR_EVIDENCE : Collect/verify native broker MTF, DQ, alignment, lineage and terminal root
- METAEDITOR_EVIDENCE -> FINAL_CLOSURE : Compile exact canonical EA and verify semantic log + fresh EX5 + tool/source provenance
- FINAL_CLOSURE -> READ_ONLY_VERIFIED : Bind all stages to one closure_run_id and verify existing evidence read-only

### FLOW-MTF4-STRATEGY — MTF-4 deterministic Strategy Challenger

Evaluate deterministic H4 context, H1 setup, M15 direction and M5 timing roles while preserving M15 as sole direction authority and stopping at Strategy Challenger eligibility.

Authority: EA_v2_00/baseline/Max_MTF.mq5 + ModelLab/strategy/mtf4_strategy.py + ModelLab/strategy/strategy_optimizer.py

- M15_DIRECTION -> H4_CONTEXT_VETO : Preserve M15 direction and apply H4 context gate
- H4_CONTEXT_VETO -> H1_SETUP_VETO : Continue only when H4 passes
- H1_SETUP_VETO -> M5_TIMING_VETO : Continue only when H1 passes
- M5_TIMING_VETO -> TAKE_OR_SKIP : Latest fully closed M5 may veto timing but never reverse direction
- TAKE_OR_SKIP -> STRATEGY_CHALLENGER_ELIGIBLE : Qualified optimizer evidence may register Strategy Challenger only
- STRATEGY_CHALLENGER_ELIGIBLE -> OWNER_RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE : Verify accepted-main source binding, MetaEditor compile, MT5/Python parity and identical-window/cost control-versus-Challenger evidence without promotion

### FLOW-PROMOTION — Explicit Strategy and Model promotion

Promote an eligible Strategy or Model Challenger only through explicit governed promotion paths.

Authority: Strategy promotion: strategy_challenger_registry; Model promotion: factory governance; Owner action is explicit.

- CHALLENGER -> ELIGIBILITY_REVALIDATED : Reload current evidence and revalidate candidate/authority identity
- ELIGIBILITY_REVALIDATED -> PROMOTED_CHAMPION : Execute explicit legal promotion
- ELIGIBILITY_REVALIDATED -> REJECTED : Eligibility or identity check fails

### FLOW-RELEASE — Active release identity and zero-Champion lifecycle

Load/validate the active release mirror, enforce EA identity parity, and preserve zero-Champion baseline until explicit promotion.

Authority: ModelLab/core/release_authority.py

- LOAD -> VALIDATE_IDENTITY : Read package/runtime active release mirrors and portable artifact paths
- VALIDATE_IDENTITY -> BASELINE_NOT_CHAMPION : Accept valid baseline with null Strategy/Model Champion
- VALIDATE_IDENTITY -> CHAMPION_BOUND_RELEASE : Accept release only when promoted authority and artifact identity are valid
- VALIDATE_IDENTITY -> FAIL_CLOSED : Reject path/hash/version/mirror mismatch

### FLOW-SCIENTIST — Scientist read-only reasoning and guarded Python analysis

Build read-only project evidence, perform bounded LLM reasoning/optional guarded analysis, and return advisory output without governance mutation.

Authority: Scientist may recommend; deterministic model/research/governance code decides admissibility and outcome.

- CONTEXT_BUILD -> ROUTE_LLM : Verify/read sealed evidence and construct bounded context
- ROUTE_LLM -> OPTIONAL_PYTHON_ANALYSIS : Parse explicit bounded analysis request when needed
- OPTIONAL_PYTHON_ANALYSIS -> ADVISORY_RESPONSE : Run capability-allowlisted child analysis and return evidence
- ROUTE_LLM -> ADVISORY_RESPONSE : Return evidence-grounded advisory answer
- OPTIONAL_PYTHON_ANALYSIS -> REASONING_ONLY_FALLBACK : Analysis runtime unavailable/rejected

### FLOW-STRATEGY-OPTIMIZER — Strategy Optimizer to Strategy Challenger

Run bounded native MT5 parameter optimization, apply deterministic KPI eligibility, and stop after registering a Strategy Challenger.

Authority: ModelLab/strategy/strategy_optimizer_jobs.py + strategy_optimizer_worker.py + strategy_challenger_registry.py

- REQUEST_FROZEN -> ROUND_PREPARED : Freeze KPI/search/date/symbol/timeframe/non-secret Scientist routing
- ROUND_PREPARED -> MT5_RUNNING : Launch one native MT5 optimization round
- MT5_RUNNING -> REPORT_READY : Accept only new/changed compatible MT5 report
- REPORT_READY -> PARSED : Parse passes and apply deterministic KPI gates
- PARSED -> STRATEGY_CHALLENGER_FOUND : Select eligible winner and register Challenger
- PARSED -> NO_WINNER_REFINE : No eligible winner and round budget remains
- NO_WINNER_REFINE -> ROUND_PREPARED : Launch next bounded round
- PARSED -> NO_CHAMPION_MAX_ROUNDS : Exhaust frozen round budget without eligible winner

### FLOW-UI-BOOTSTRAP — Control Room Python/UI bootstrap

Resolve canonical Python 3.12 environment, repair dependencies if required, and start Streamlit Control Room without making runtime-render claims from source startup alone.

Authority: ModelLab/ui/ui_bootstrap.py + ModelLab/ui/ui_launcher.py

- BOOTSTRAP -> PYTHON_312_RESOLVED : Discover/install canonical Python 3.12 authority
- PYTHON_312_RESOLVED -> ENV_READY : Resolve/create MAX venv and dependency state
- ENV_READY -> STREAMLIT_STARTED : Launch Control Room process
- BOOTSTRAP -> FAILED : Fail closed on missing/unrepairable canonical environment

## Mutable vs immutable

### Mutable current state

- source: Public source authority is maxqstudio/max-mtf main. Work branches are candidates until required GitHub source/governance checks pass and they are merged.
- runtime: MT5, MetaEditor, browser, CUDA, ONNX and other environment-dependent runtime behavior requires candidate-bound Owner evidence at the end of the applicable phase; private runtime evidence is not committed to the public repository.
- acceptance: GitHub Actions proves source safety, source contracts and governance for the exact Git candidate. Owner runtime acceptance separately proves environment-dependent MT5/MetaEditor behavior at phase end.
- strategy_lifecycle: Optimizer winner becomes Strategy Challenger; only explicit Owner promotion may replace Strategy Champion.
- model_lifecycle: Factory winner becomes Model Challenger; deterministic governance and explicit promotion control Champion mutation.
- release: Release identity and runtime artifact parity are verified from source authority plus Owner-held candidate-bound evidence; generated/compiled release payloads are excluded from public Git.
- documentation: For STRICT governance, canonical Markdown under docs/ is generated and must not be manually maintained as upstream authority.

### Immutable history / evidence

- data: M5 is canonical value authority; M15/H1/H4 are deterministically derived and native higher-timeframe data is parity evidence.
- scientist: Scientist may analyze evidence and propose bounded experiments but cannot own deterministic gate, promotion, or protected holdout authority.
- historical_reference: Historical runtime/evidence archives do not override current public source authority and are intentionally not copied into maxqstudio/max-mtf.

### Configuration vs execution snapshot

Configuration/snapshot semantics come from authority and workflow specs. The
compiler does not infer them from implementation names.

## Failure and recovery

- FLOW-EA-RUNTIME: Invalid runtime/release/model identity must not be treated as production authority.
- FLOW-LOCAL-ACCEPTANCE: First gate/evidence mismatch is terminal for the run; stale candidate binding fails current-evidence sync.
- FLOW-MODEL-FACTORY: Scientific, resource, seal, lineage or policy mismatch fails closed; terminal failures remain auditable.
- FLOW-MTF1-CLOSURE: Any identity, parity, causality, data-quality, compile, or evidence mismatch fails closed.
- FLOW-MTF1-CLOSURE: Missing external evidence remains NOT_PROVEN; it is never inferred from source tests.
- FLOW-MTF4-STRATEGY: Any missing, stale, future or invalid role input returns SKIP/fail-closed.
- FLOW-MTF4-STRATEGY: Owner runtime/backtest evidence remains NOT_PROVEN until phase-end execution.
- FLOW-PROMOTION: Any stale/missing/failed eligibility evidence blocks promotion.
- FLOW-RELEASE: Any identity/mirror/path mismatch fails closed before deployment authority is consumed.
- FLOW-SCIENTIST: Provider/analysis failure falls back or fails closed according to call contract; it cannot mutate deterministic Factory authority.
- FLOW-STRATEGY-OPTIMIZER: Ambiguous/stale report provenance, missing Weighted-R evidence, invalid compile/runtime identity, or registry inconsistency fails closed.
- FLOW-UI-BOOTSTRAP: Bootstrap or dependency failure stops launch with explicit diagnostics.
